hypothesis: Class-member observer reports a current on-disk hash but does not bind it to the code loaded at initialization; a changed producer can be mislabeled as the producer of old loaded logic.
controlled_observation: Patch read_bytes only for the producer path to simulate changed disk bytes after module load; do not alter preserved source artifacts. Old observer should incorrectly report positive facts with changed producer hash; corrected observer should refuse.
scope: Owned trusted-process drift control, no source-family independence claim.
